name: Lake
rule: Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; the way round follows the shore.

name: Open ground
rule: Open grassland and scrub. Easy going: travel on foot.

name: Forest
rule: Forest without a path. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Hills
rule: Hills and broken ground. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Fen
rule: Marsh and fen. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Desert
rule: Sand and scrub. Tough going in heat: travel by rough_terrain, and carry water.

name: Tundra
rule: Cold, open ground. Tough going in weather: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Glacier
rule: Ice and crevasses. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain, and rope up.

name: Volcano
rule: Ash, lava, and poisonous air. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Jungle
rule: Dense tropical forest. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Moor
rule: Heath and peat. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Steppe
rule: Open grassy plain. Easy going: travel on foot.

name: Badlands
rule: Eroded gullies and broken rock. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Farmland
rule: Tilled fields and hedgerows. Easy going while the tracks are dry: travel on foot.

name: Ocean
rule: Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; a boat is needed.

name: Reef
rule: Shallow coral water. Small boats may cross slowly; larger craft cannot.

name: Island
rule: An isolated shore. Easy going on the land; reaching it needs a boat.

name: Plateau
rule: Raised tableland. Tough going up or down the rim: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Mountains
rule: Mountain country. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain; passes are few.

name: Swamp
rule: Bog and standing water. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Coast
rule: Shoreline and coastal water. Easy going along the shore; boats keep close in.

name: River
rule: Flowing water. Cross at a ford, bridge, or boat; the banks are easy going.

name: Meadow
rule: Flower meadows and soft grass. Easy going on foot.

name: Pinewood
rule: Dark conifer forest. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Canyon
rule: Sheer walls and a broken floor. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Salt Flat
rule: Cracked white pan. Easy going when dry, but there is no water or cover.

name: Ashland
rule: Cold ash and cinders. Tough going, and the air stings the throat.

name: Lagoon
rule: Calm, shallow water. Cross by boat or wade the warm shallows.

name: Orchard
rule: Rows of fruit trees and mown grass. Easy going between the trunks.

name: Highland
rule: Wind-scoured upland. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.

name: Bog
rule: Deep, sucking bog. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain, and test the ground.
